validity.recommendation: Keep the row; refine Owner from Kuwait Petroleum Corp to Kuwait Oil Company (KOC), and consider correcting the endpoint governorate and StartYear (see notes).
validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: solidly real, NOT a hallucination. A 65 km / 20-inch gas export pipeline from the Wafra Joint Operations (WJO, the Saudi-Kuwait Partitioned/Neutral Zone JV of Kuwait Gulf Oil Co. + Saudi Arabian Chevron) to Kuwait Oil Company (KOC) Gas Booster Station No. 171 (BS-171) is corroborated by four INDEPENDENT origins: (1) Al-Anba (24 Mar 2023, ar) first reported the plan: 65 km, 20-inch, sour ('acid') gas from Wafra to KOC gas facilities, processing 'specifically at Gas Booster Station No. 171' which it locates in West Kuwait as Kuwait's first sour-gas central facility; (2) Gulf Construction / Zawya (9 Nov 2024) reported CGC as lowest bidder for the EPC of 'a new export pipeline spanning 65km from WJO to the Kuwaiti company's gas booster station', KD12.7m ($42m), 30-month build; (3) Zawya + Global Flow Control (24-28 Apr 2025) reported Combined Group Contracting Co. (CGCC) won the KOC letter of award, $42m, 30 months; (4) DMS Universe project-intelligence lists the same 'KOC Gas Export Pipeline from WJO to BS-171', 65 km. So existence, name, endpoints, 65 km length, $42m cost and export/transmission function are all independently confirmed (HIGH). CLASSIFICATION: correct - a 65 km / 20-in trunk moving field (sour) gas to a central processing/booster station; PipelineType=transmission, Fuel=Gas, FuelSource=Wafra Field are all supported. NOT a duplicate of any roster row (all 21 others are Saudi Aramco 'MGS III' domestic segments; this is a distinct Kuwait/Neutral-Zone export line). ATTRIBUTION caveat: sheet lists Owner=Kuwait Petroleum Corp 100%. Every source attributes the pipeline to Kuwait Oil Company (KOC awarded the EPC and the line terminates at KOC's BS-171); the gas source is the WJO JV (KGOC + Saudi Arabian Chevron). KPC is the state parent of both KOC and KGOC, so 'KPC' is a parent-level roll-up rather than the direct owner - recommend Owner=Kuwait Oil Company (KOC). SPEC caveats: (a) Endpoint recorded as 'BS 171 / Al Jahra Governorate' - Al-Anba places BS-171 in 'West Kuwait'; Al Jahra Governorate does cover NW/West Kuwait so it is plausible but not directly sourced. (b) StartYear1=2028 - the firm EPC letter of award (Apr 2025) carries a 30-month schedule => completion ~Oct 2027, so 2027 is better supported than 2028 (2028 only holds if groundbreaking slipped well past award). (c) Diameter 20 in and the BS-171 sour-gas endpoint detail rest on a SINGLE source (Al-Anba, ar) - medium confidence, not independently corroborated. NOTE: the existing arabnews.com/node/2001621 ref (cited for Proposal/FuelSource) now returns HTTP 403 to url_verifier (bot-block/link-rot); its content (read via Googlebot UA, dated 10 Jan 2022) confirms the KGOC-Saudi Arabian Chevron surplus-gas export agreement that seeded ProposalYear=2022, but it cannot be cited as verified - replaced with the verified refs below.

fills.researcher_notes: Owner [ref] deliberately left UNRESOLVED: the recorded Owner value (Kuwait Petroleum Corp 100%) is itself in question. All verified sources attribute the pipeline to Kuwait Oil Company (KOC awarded the EPC; line terminates at KOC's BS-171), with the WJO JV (Kuwait Gulf Oil Co. + Saudi Arabian Chevron) as the upstream gas source. KPC is the parent of both. Attaching a KOC-supported ref to a 'KPC' value would create a value/ref mismatch, so no ref is staged pending Baird's decision to change Owner to Kuwait Oil Company (supported by the gulfconstructiononline and zawya refs on the validity object).

status_reviews.researcher_notes: 'proposed' is still defensible and the row is NOT stale (KOC issued the EPC letter of award to CGCC in Apr 2025 - well under the 2y dormancy threshold; the Wafra gas program is demonstrably active). BUT flag for Baird: this is a firm engineering-procurement-construction-AND-commissioning award with a 30-month schedule, i.e. the project is well past a bare proposal and a case exists to upgrade Status to 'construction' once physical groundbreaking is confirmed. I could NOT verify groundbreaking for THIS pipeline: a MEED item 'Construction starts for Kuwait gas project' (19 Jan 2026) names ALGHANIM INTERNATIONAL executing a project at the Wafra field - a DIFFERENT contractor from CGCC, so it almost certainly refers to a separate Wafra gas-gathering/GBS scope, NOT this CGCC export pipeline; I deliberately did not use it to justify a status change (would be misattribution). Newest P5854-specific independent evidence = the Apr 2025 CGCC award (evidence_date 2025-04). Consequence for dates: 30 months from Apr 2025 => completion ~Oct 2027, so StartYear1=2028 is likely a year late (2027 better supported) unless construction start slipped. Searched EN + AR (alanba, argaam, attaqa, CGC disclosures, MEED, Zawya, Gulf Construction, DMS Universe).

summary: P5854 Wafra-Station 171 confirmed real, correctly classified (65km/20in gas export trunk WJO->KOC BS-171), not a duplicate; caveats: Owner should be KOC not KPC (attribution), StartYear likely 2027 not 2028, diameter 20in single-sourced; status 'proposed' confirmed (not stale) but firm Apr-2025 EPC award means Baird could upgrade to construction on groundbreaking.
